Review title: Pop-up Didn’t Pop-up
Review text: I purchased this pop-up gift box last year and thought it was so cute, so I bought another one this year. Unfortunately, the pop-up insert was damaged and didn’t pop up. Just disappointed it arrived damage.

Review text: I was so embarrassed giving my parents cards that weren’t activated for their Christmas gifts. They saved them to use on amazons cyber deals and neither card worked.
